title: What's a Seashell Doing on Top of the Hill?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: At the very top of the highest hill, far from the sea, a villager finds a seashell set in the rock.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: At the very top of the highest hill on Isola, far from the sea, (name1) finds a seashell. Not one somebody dropped: it's stuck in the rock itself, part of the stone, as if the hill grew around it. (He/She) traces its ridges with a fingertip. It's a shell. There's no doubt about it. But the sea is a long way below, and the hill is very old, and (name1) cannot for the life of (him/her) think how a shell got up here and into the rock. Was the sea once here? Was the hill once under the sea? Did a bird bring it, and the rock grow round it? (name1) sits beside it for a long time, looking down at the faraway waves, feeling very small and very curious, and then walks home without an answer.
